subject: Token economics, blended rates, and adding a rerank/embed route - next steps
messages:
From: Sarah Lee <sarah.lee@greenleaf.health>
To: rachel.kim@redwood.ai, ben.carter@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@greenleaf.health
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro + pilot recap / follow-up on pricing

Thanks for the demo today, Rachel and Ben — appreciate the deep dive. A couple quick clarifying points from our side as we map internal budget: 

- Current monthly usage (prod sap integration): ~18M tokens/month, mostly generation (assistant-style) with occasional long-form (avg seq length ~900 tokens).
- We plan a Q4 expansion that could ramp to ~45–55M tokens/month if routing and latency hold.
- There is a new reranking pipeline (high-frequency, short contexts) that would add ~8–12M tokens/month but requires a cheaper $/1M target.

For budgeting, finance is asking for a target headline number for 1M tokens for a blended profile (generation + rerank + embedding/lookups). They suggested a target range: $500–$850 per 1M tokens depending on committed volumes. Can you confirm what a blended $/1M looks like at the 20M / 50M / 80M bands and whether we can add a separate lower-rate routing for rerank-only traffic?

Also attaching the projection sheet finance uses (see procurement address). Happy to hop on a quick follow if you need more detail.

—Sarah
[attachment: GreenLeaf_projections_Q3-Q4.pdf (application/pdf)]

From: rachel.kim@redwood.ai
To: Sarah Lee <sarah.lee@greenleaf.health>
Cc: ben.carter@redwood.ai, aditya.rao@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 11 May 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro + pilot recap / follow-up on pricing

Hi Sarah — thanks for the clear summary and the projection PDF. Quick recap from our side and the asks we'll take into pricing: 

1) Volume bands to price: 20M / 50M / 80M tokens/month (you listed 18M baseline — we’ll round to 20M for banding).
2) Traffic mix assumptions: generation = 75% (longer avg seq ~900), embeddings/lookup = 10%, rerank = 15% (short seq). 
3) Requirement: separate routing for rerank pipeline so you can land that on a lower-cost model/instance class; call this "rerank-route" in the SOW.
4) Target blended $/1M from finance: $500–$850. We’ll propose both committed and on-demand blends.

Next steps from Redwood: Ben and I will build a 1-page unit econ showing blended per-band rates (committed vs on-demand) and an example routing plan that maps rerank-route to a cheaper model variant. Aditya will run a quick costing for the rerank route (CPU-friendly model + quantized profile) and attach the workbook. We aim to get something over to you by end of week.

Does that timeline work? If procurement wants a redline-able term sheet, we can prepare a draft T&Cs for the Dedicated/Reserved tier as an optional add-on.

Thanks,
Rachel
Rachel Kim
Senior Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
[Redwood Inference | rachel.kim@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0123]

From: aditya.rao@redwood.ai
To: Sarah Lee <sarah.lee@greenleaf.health>, rachel.kim@redwood.ai
Cc: ben.carter@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 12 May 2027 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Intro + pilot recap / follow-up on pricing

Sarah — attaching a unit-econ workbook with a couple of scenarios and kernel assumptions. High-level notes below: 

- Rerank-route costing: we modeled a 4x lower per-token compute cost when routing to a quantized rerank model (short sequences, batched). For planning, that reduces effective $/1M for rerank traffic to roughly 30–40% of the gen cost depending on committed GPU type.
- Generation (long-form) remains the dominant cost driver; batching + KV cache assumptions push per-token compute down ~15% at 50M tokens band vs 20M.
- Blended examples in sheet: 20M -> $780/1M (on-demand blend), 50M -> $620/1M (committed mix), 80M -> $540/1M (aggressive commit + rerank-route split). These are placeholders pending your exact routing split.

See attached: redwood_unit_econ_v2.xlsx. Happy to walk through the calc on a call.

—Aditya
Aditya Rao
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
[attachment: redwood_unit_econ_v2.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)]

From: Sarah Lee <sarah.lee@greenleaf.health>
To: rachel.kim@redwood.ai, aditya.rao@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@greenleaf.health
Date: Fri, 14 May 2027 10:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro + pilot recap / follow-up on pricing

Thanks Aditya — reviewed the workbook. Quick clarifications from finance/procurement: 

- Confirming volumes: Baseline we’ll use 20M for now with a committed uplift plan to 50M by Nov (Q4) if SLA/latency targets are met; longer-term planning number 75–80M.
- Rerank-route: target is to land rerank-only traffic at <= $300/1M tokens if possible (finance goal). Will accept routing to a smaller/quantized model variant only for those calls.
- Blended target: finance would be very happy at <$600/1M at the 50M committed band. They recognize long-form gen costs more and are ok if rerank routing makes the blended average attractive.

Can you produce a two-column summary: (A) committed 12mo pricing schedule by band (20/50/80) with per-band blended $/1M and (B) routing appendix showing model variants and per-route $/1M (rerank-route, gen-route, embed-route)? Procurement wants that in the term sheet.

If you can get that to us by EOD next Tuesday (18 May), we’ll try to loop in legal/procurement and schedule a procurement review the week of May 24.

—Sarah

From: ben.carter@redwood.ai
To: Sarah Lee <sarah.lee@greenleaf.health>, procurement@greenleaf.health
Cc: rachel.kim@redwood.ai, aditya.rao@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 17 May 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Token economics, blended rates, and adding a rerank/embed route - next steps

Appreciate the clarity, Sarah — we’ll deliver exactly what procurement asked for. Plan: 

- Deliverable A (by EOD Tue 18 May): 1-page committed pricing table (20/50/80) with blended $/1M and a short note on assumptions (batching, KV cache, quantization mix).
- Deliverable B (by EOD Tue 18 May): Routing appendix that lists per-route recommended model variants + estimated $/1M for each route (rerank-route at targeted <= $300/1M if we can meet the batching/quantization assumptions, gen-route, embed-route).
- Follow-up: schedule a 30-min procurement prep on Wed 19 May to review the term sheet and any commercial questions. I’ll put a Doodle shortly.

Also flagging that for the 50M committed band we typically require a 12-month commit with quarterly telemetry reviews; if that works for you we’ll draft a short SOW + T&Cs and share a DocuSign link to get the procurement process moving faster. HubSpot deal ID: DL-3492.

Thanks — Ben
